authorization: The user chose exactly one unseen cat versus one known cat and approved a quarantined retrospective exploratory experiment.
target: Comparisons with exactly one held-out cat and one different nonreserved cat represented in the separate fitting data. Both photos must have usable H, C and Y features.
nonclaims: G4 was not reserved before G2/G3 outcome access, and results are not an independent or confirmatory test.
Uncertainty intervals are descriptive, conditional on fitted models and model selection, and do not account for all shared known-cat, photo or respondent dependence.
No causal effect, deployment decision, new primary G2 claim, or change to G2/G3 artifacts follows.

reservation.universe: Cats in labeled training responses, with cats connected by exact duplicate photo content grouped together.
reservation.order: Ascending SHA-256 of UTF-8 'retrospective-g4-20261028:' followed by JSON-encoded sorted cat IDs of each group; break ties by encoded IDs.
reservation.groups_per_partition: floor(0.10 * number of duplicate-aware cat groups), at least one; first groups are test, next are validation.
reservation.justification: Ten percent is specified before reservation to allow at least 20 held-out cats in each partition when 237 groups are available.

separate_core.population: Responses with both cats nonreserved and usable admitted H, C and Y photo features.
separate_core.split: Separate 70/15/15 pair split using the existing pair-band allocation rules and seed 20261028. Only fitting responses train G4 models.
separate_core.cross_reserved: All responses involving two reserved cats, a reserved cat against another reserved partition, or a reserved cat compared to itself are quarantined.

coverage_gate_per_partition.failure: Report insufficient coverage and do not fit or evaluate G4. Thresholds are operational and are not power guarantees.

models.M1-zero: Train cat-identity M1 on core fitting cats; assign score zero to the unseen cat and retain the known fitting-cat score. Zero is a fixed cold-start convention, not a learned unseen-cat score or a claim that the unseen cat is average.
models.M2: Excluded: no fitted free photo score exists for an unseen cat's photos.
models.preprocessing: Fit on unique separate-core fitting photos only, using the existing frozen H/C/Y preprocessing implementations.
models.context: pet_care; fitting-only support of at least 100 responses and 30 pairs; largest supported group is reference, lexical tie; unsupported groups use zero deviation.
models.fallback: Exact pooled M3 predictions are candidates for the matching M4 model.
models.selection: G4 validation loss only; tolerance 1e-6; stronger ridge, stronger context shrinkage, and exact pooled fallback preferred for ties. Select M3* among H, C, Y with that fixed tie order and retain matched M4*.
models.test_freeze: Write and hash experiment-specific selection and fitted preprocessing/model artifacts before parsing reserved G4 test outcomes.

evaluation.confidence: 95% pointwise descriptive intervals, not multiplicity adjusted
evaluation.metric: response-weighted natural-log loss; Brier score and accuracy are secondary
evaluation.guard: Evaluate once only after validating the G4 freeze; no test-driven tuning or deployment selection.
